titulo.alumno: Novice · Places and basic directions: Listening comprehension

intro: T1 · Beginner · Recognise letters, vocabulary and common phrases; understand basic grammar structures and short sentences from everyday life. Topic: Places and basic directions. Focus: Listening comprehension (optional).

texto: Listening to directions: on the street, the answer to a question about the way is usually quick and sequential. Train your ear to recognise the connector «แล้ว» [lɛ́ɛo, and then] between two movement verbs: «ตรงไปแล้วเลี้ยวซ้าย» [trong bpai lɛ́ɛo líao sáai]. Identifying whether the final instruction is «ซ้าย» (left, high tone) or «ขวา» (right, rising tone) is crucial.
